{D(AdminChar)} has made a remarkable find among the scrap

An ancient document imprinter and seal stamp, this was used to print verified government documents.

Though created by the pre-Collapse League of Spacefaring Nations, it was modified by House Khalil, a house that once dominated the galaxy, to emboss their coat of arms. 

This could improve our administration by accelerating bureaucratic throughput and making forgery harder. But it could also be used for intrigue, if we keep it secret.

The pre-Collapse document press can be used to forge documents: to improve your House’s standing, slander another House, or forge a claim. It can also be incorporated into your administrative apparatus.

<helptext>- Forging a claim on a star system</helptext> is done from that system’s action menu.
<helptext>- Slandering another House</helptext> is done from that House’s action menu.
<helptext>- Improving your House’s standing, or using the machine for administration,</helptext> is done from your own House’s action menu.</helptext>
Use the press to forge a document "proving" {PlayerHouse} once ruled {TargetSystem}

“{PlayerHouse} is granted the territory of {TargetSystem} in perpetuity; so decrees the noble House of Khalil”
Naysayers are sceptical, but nobody can deny this document bears House Khalil’s seal.
Your arms brimming with forged papers, you hurry from the press...

...right into a gaggle of dignitaries.

"{PlayerCharacter}, whatever are you doing?"

“In the event of a civilisational collapse, we beg the people of the future to rebuild the League.” The wording is so precise, and fits post-Collapse society so specifically, this must be forgery. 

This document came from your press, but you have no idea who had access. This could reveal the press's existence and embarrass your House.

Tests your security skill. If you succeed, this problem goes away. If you fail, the longterm outcome might be worse than revealing the secret now.
You make camp outside the print room and try to catch the forger in the act

A shape moves in the darkness; you bring your torch to bear. {D(Character)} is hunched over the press. {He(Character)} pales, backing against it.

“Why put words in the League’s mouth?” you demand.

“We used to work together,” {he(Character)} whispers. “We lived in safety. Now look at us! Divided, hateful... I want us to rebuild, together.”
